Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human Cytochrome P450 2C9. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering for target name 'Cytochrome P450 2C9' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures to require structures. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
